question: Basketball has two teams, consist of _________ players on each team.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Five**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A game of** Basketball is played with two teams, with ****5**** players f**rom each team on the court at one time (that means 10 playing at one time).
 
• The maximum number of players on the bench differs by the league you’re playing in.
 
• **In international play, a maximum of 7 players is allowed on the bench, resulting in a roster of 12 players**
 
• Yadwinder Singh is the current captain of the Indian basketball team. 
 
• **Akanksha Singh i**s the current captain of India Women's National Basketball Team.
